claims.content: Customer
User is logged in to the site.
User has a valid credit card on file (or has just added one).
Auction item is currently active and accepting bids.
User has not already placed a winning bid on this item.
The customer navigates to an active auction item page.
The system displays the current high bid and the 'Place Bid' section.
The customer enters a bid amount that is higher than the current bid (and meets any reserve price).
The customer clicks the 'Place Bid' button.
The system validates the bid amount against the current bid and any minimum increment rules.
The system confirms the user's identity and payment method status (pre-authorized or valid card on file).
The system places the bid, updates the current high bid on the page, and records the new bidder as the temporary winner.
The system displays a confirmation message to the customer indicating their bid was successfully placed.
If the bid amount entered is not higher than the current high bid or does not meet the minimum increment, the system displays an error message and prompts the user to enter a valid amount.

If the user's identity cannot be confirmed or their payment method is invalid/expired, the system redirects them to the 'My Account' page to update their information before allowing the bid to proceed.

If another user places a higher bid between the time the current user clicks 'Place Bid' and the system processes it (a race condition), the system rejects the bid, informs the user they have been outbid, and displays the new current high bid.
If the auction ends while the user is in the process of placing a bid, the system prevents the bid from being placed and notifies the user that the auction has closed.
The customer's bid is recorded in the system as the new high bid.
The auction item page displays the updated 'Current Bid' amount reflecting the customer's bid.
The customer is listed as the temporary winner of the auction item.
A notification email is sent to the previous high bidder informing them they have been outbid.
A confirmation email is sent to the customer acknowledging their successful bid placement.
If the user does not have a pre-authorized credit card, the authorized amount for the bid is reserved/charged against their payment method on file.
